page_about.title: About Rimelight
page_about.description: Learn about Rimelight Entertainment and our starter template.
page_about.hero_description: We craft beautiful, modern, high-performance web experiences designed to scale and empower developers.
page_about.section_values_description: The ideas that drive how we build our templates and application frameworks.
page_about.value_dx_description: We believe tooling should be fast, seamless, and intuitive, getting out of your way so you can create.

page_about.section_about_template_description: This is a unified starter template designed to bundle all our core UI elements, auth integration, localization, and robust database setups in a single place. Rather than maintaining dozens of fragments, we build one powerful base—allowing you to easily disable what you don't need.
